privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Moneyflow is an educational portfolio project. This page explains, in plain words, what is stored and how to remove it.

stored.title: What we store
stored.body: Your sign-in identity from Firebase Authentication (an anonymous id for guests, or your Google name, email and photo), and the data you enter: profile, incomes, costs, debts, accounts, goals, transactions, budgets, health scores and check-ins. It lives in Google Cloud Firestore under your account id, and security rules let only you read or write it.

ai.title: What the AI sees
ai.body: When you use an AI feature, the server sends Google's Gemini API only what that feature needs: computed totals and categories, goal and debt names, your chat messages, or transaction descriptions you ask to categorize. Moneyflow keeps the resulting text (for example a check-in) in your account, plus a daily request counter. The API key never reaches your browser.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Checkout runs on Stripe in test mode. Card details go to Stripe, never to Moneyflow. We store only your plan and Stripe's customer and subscription ids.

browser.title: In your browser
browser.body: We keep your language choice in local storage and unfinished setup answers and the coach conversation in session storage, which clears when you close the tab. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.

control.title: Export and delete
control.body: In Settings you can export everything as CSV files and delete your account. Deleting removes your data, your plan record and usage counter, cancels any test subscription, and deletes your sign-in.

notStored.title: What we never do
notStored.body: No bank connections, no selling or sharing of data, and no investment, tax, legal or credit advice.
